body:
A living room absorbs more than you realize — the friction of a hard conversation, the static of a long commute, the weight of a full day. Most spaces just hold onto it. Harmonious Home is built to do something different.

This is the first bundle in Energy Muse's Frequency Formula system — Heather's translation of nearly 40 years of Feng Shui and home-healing knowledge into a modern, room-specific frequency architecture. Each formula is layered in three parts, not stacked randomly, but built like an architecture: one frequency clears the space, one stabilizes it, and one directs it toward what that room is actually for.

For the living room, that architecture looks like this:

Clear — 417Hz invites the release of friction and what you carried home, so the room isn't holding onto your day.

Stabilize — 639Hz holds the space in softness, easing tension and returning the room to a steady baseline.

Direct — 963Hz aims the space toward open communication and mental ease — the frequency of connection.

Run alone, a single frequency shifts a moment. Run together, the three build an environment. This bundle includes all three frequency generators, engineered with precision-etched copper coils and sacred geometry patterning, alongside a display case designed to house them as a cohesive piece and a canvas generator bag for on-the-go use. Heather runs this exact trio in her own living room — clear, stabilize, direct, on repeat.

Harmonious Home invites your space into a regulated, consistent state — a room your nervous system can return to.
